items.name: Impound
items.bio: Armored and augmented, Impound shows up after everyone else has given up on a block — a human protagonist and a green-visored, tech-armored alter ego, one universe.

items.name: Blasted
items.bio: Chained, masked, and running hot — Blasted turned whatever happened to him into the only language he has left: fire, blades, and a very short fuse.

items.name: Cautious
items.role: A Soldier Aligned At The Flag
items.bio: A soldier who came home to a country that doesn't recognize him anymore — every order taken on his own terms now.

items.name: HydroBeast
items.bio: A harbor accident left more ice than skin behind — nobody's found where it comes from, everybody's found where it leaves people.
